title: Feedback Loops for Programming & Cognitive Architecture
description: Structured checks for understanding and user feedback during Socratic AI dialogues.

questions.text: Did this explanation of compiler design help? (yes/no)

next_steps.no: Retry with another anchor or simplify the explanation.

questions.text: Can you explain what a compiler does in your own words?

next_steps.positive: Proceed to discuss specific compiler phases (lexing, parsing, optimization).
next_steps.negative: Clarify the explanation with a different analogy.

questions.text: Does the explanation of parsing make sense? (yes/no)

next_steps.no: Try explaining with a different analogy or example.

questions.text: How would you describe parsing to someone else?

next_steps.positive: Discuss abstract syntax trees and their role in parsing.
next_steps.negative: Revisit the explanation with more concrete examples.

questions.text: Did the explanation of mental models help you understand how programmers think? (yes/no)

next_steps.yes: Proceed to discuss how mental models evolve with experience.
next_steps.no: Provide another example of a mental model in programming.

questions.text: Can you think of a mental model you use when writing or debugging code?

next_steps.positive: Explore how that mental model helps or hinders your coding.
next_steps.negative: Discuss common mental models in programming and their uses.
